data.name: btnAddFile.ToolTip
data.value: Add a file or multiple files from a single directory.

data.name: btnAddDirectory.ToolTip
data.value: Add all acceptable spectrum files found below a root directory. You can uncheck ones you do not want added to the library.

data.name: cbIncludeAmbiguousMatches.ToolTip
data.value: Check to keep spectra that match multiple peptides.

data.name: comboAction.ToolTip
data.value: Choose to create a new library or append to an existing library, if you have previously saved a copy of the redundant library data.

data.name: cbKeepRedundant.ToolTip
data.value: Check to keep a copy of the redundant library to which you can append more spectra in the future.

data.name: cbFilter.ToolTip
data.value: Check to filter matches for only the peptides in the document.

data.name: textPath.ToolTip
data.value: Location on disk at which the final non-redundant library will be created.

data.name: textName.ToolTip
data.value: The name Skyline will use to refer to this library

data.name: labelAlphaInfo.Text
data.value:
Osprey predicts fragment intensities and retention times for the precursors with AlphaPeptDeep's models.
The pages that follow choose what to predict for and the model: the pretrained models, a saved fine-tuned model, or one fine-tuned on DIA runs first.

data.name: labelPredictFor.Text
data.value: Predict spectra and retention times for:

data.value: The peptides and precursors of a protein &FASTA file, digested with the document settings:

data.name: labelLibraryModel.Text
data.value: Choose the model AlphaPeptDeep predicts the library with, or fine-tune a new model on DIA runs, which Osprey searches against a protein FASTA first.

data.name: labelFasta.Text
data.value: The protein FASTA the fine-tuning runs are searched against, and how Osprey digests it for the training library.

data.name: labelModifications.Text
data.value: The fixed and variable modifications the training library carries. They start as the document's modifications.

data.name: labelSearchSettings.Text
data.value: Configure the Osprey search of the fine-tuning runs. Peptide length, precursor charges and the modification limit come from the document settings.
